tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background. Everything sits on this warm grey; never pure white as a full screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels on ground: chips, inactive day pill, ruler track, secondary cards.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: inactive ticks, empty grid cells, pressed state of surface controls.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: The one loud card per screen (current message, active task). Inverts in dark.

tokens.name: on-card
tokens.usage: Text and icons on card (16:1 both themes).

tokens.name: on-card-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on card: times, sources, hints (7.1:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground and surface; fill of the primary circle button.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Icon on an ink-filled button.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on ground and surface: labels, the trailing minutes in 09:41 (5.3:1 light, 7.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: past/future numerals on a picker, idle ticks. Fails 4.5:1 — never for information.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines and ruler ticks.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single signal colour: live dot, pause/active button fill, the 'now' tick. Fill only, ink on top (6:1); never text on ground (2.6:1 light).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Icon or text on accent.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: AI states only — listening, thinking, Qube suggestions. Fill or large type on card; never small text on ground in light (2.6:1).

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Price up (A-share convention: red = up). Text on ground/surface 4.6:1+. Always with ▲ and a + sign.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Price down (green = down). Text on ground/surface 5:1+. Always with ▼ and a − sign; up and down are told apart by glyph, not hue.

styles.name: numeral-xl
styles.usage: One hero number per screen: count, price %, timer.

styles.name: numeral-lg
styles.usage: Clock-style figures; trailing part in ink-muted.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One-sentence screens only (a guardrail question, the market-weather word). Larger than title; at most one per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 按一下我的头 = 已读

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: 示例数据 · 不构成投资建议

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Codes, units, axis labels, small lowercase labels.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label, tick gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and between stacked lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding of the loud card; gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top inset above the hero numeral.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The loud card; the screen corners on the 3.5" panel mock.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, day pills, circle buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Floating circle buttons and stacked cards only. Everything else is flat.
